plan.notes: Source: Nova Southeastern University Halmos College of Natural Science and Oceanography 'Sample Four Year Curriculum | 2025-2026 Catalog' for BS Biology (Premedical) (PDF updated July 2025), transcribed term by term. NSU runs Fall/Winter terms. Course codes/titles/credits taken verbatim; prereq arrays are empty (the sample plan does not publish per-course prerequisites; not invented). Physics pairs (2350/2400, 2360/2500) are catalog 'OR' alternatives occupying one slot. 'Biology Major Elective' slots: student selects 27 credits from the catalog's Major Electives list, at least 16 credits must be BIOL 3000+ or 4000+ courses with at least one of these being a BIOL course with a lab (4 credits); options below are the catalog's enumerated electives — any 3000/4000-level BIOL course (excluding BIOL 3600) also qualifies per the catalog, and no more than 6 credits (total) from each of BIOL 4900/4950/4960/4961/4990 may apply. 'Biology Major Elective with lab' slots must be a 4-credit elective with a lab (catalog recommendation: CHEM 3650 Biochemistry/Lab). PHIL slot options are the catalog's five listed PHIL courses. MCAT note from the catalog: students planning the MCAT in the summer of junior year are advised to complete CHEM 3650 or CHEM 3660 as a junior-year major elective. Plan assumes entry at MATH 1250 Trigonometry or higher (catalog note). No TCCNS in Florida; transfer_confidence is empty.
